paragraphs.source_en: When he came to Shimazu Yoshihiro, however, Mitsunari did not try to inflame him as he had the younger men. “In Mitsunari’s judgment, no one on the battlefield can rival you, my lord. Therefore, the weighty task of assaulting the main gate must fall upon your shoulders. I hope you will set a fine example for the younger men.”

units.source_en: When he came to Shimazu Yoshihiro, however, Mitsunari did not try to inflame him as he had the younger men.
units.source_zh: 到了岛津义弘那里，三成却未像对年轻人那般煽动。

units.source_en: “In Mitsunari’s judgment, no one on the battlefield can rival you, my lord.
units.source_zh: “三成认为，战场上无人能与大人并驾齐驱。

units.source_en: Therefore, the weighty task of assaulting the main gate must fall upon your shoulders.
units.source_zh: 故，此次进攻正门的重任，就落在了大人肩上。

units.source_en: I hope you will set a fine example for the younger men.”
units.source_zh: 希望大人能为年轻人立个好榜样。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 到了岛津义弘那里，三成却未像对年轻人那般煽动。“三成认为，战场上无人能与大人并驾齐驱。故，此次进攻正门的重任，就落在了大人肩上。希望大人能为年轻人立个好榜样。”

paragraphs.source_en: With Chōsokabe Morichika and Konishi Yukinaga, Mitsunari spoke openly and offered encouragement. Yukinaga in particular had shared Mitsunari’s purpose and joined the uprising with him from the outset, so naturally Mitsunari treated him with sincerity. The wife of Katō Kiyomasa, whose domain, like Yukinaga’s, lay in Higo, had long since contrived to escape home to her husband’s territory.

units.source_en: With Chōsokabe Morichika and Konishi Yukinaga, Mitsunari spoke openly and offered encouragement.
units.source_zh: 对于长曾我部盛亲和小西行长，三成则敞开心扉加以鼓励。

units.source_en: Yukinaga in particular had shared Mitsunari’s purpose and joined the uprising with him from the outset, so naturally Mitsunari treated him with sincerity.
units.source_zh: 尤其是小西行长，一开始就与三成志同道合，共同举事，他自然以诚相待。

units.source_en: The wife of Katō Kiyomasa, whose domain, like Yukinaga’s, lay in Higo, had long since contrived to escape home to her husband’s territory.
units.source_zh: 与行长领地同在肥后的加藤清正的夫人，早就巧妙地逃回了本领。

paragraphs.source_zh: 对于长曾我部盛亲和小西行长，三成则敞开心扉加以鼓励。尤其是小西行长，一开始就与三成志同道合，共同举事，他自然以诚相待。与行长领地同在肥后的加藤清正的夫人，早就巧妙地逃回了本领。

paragraphs.source_en: “Kiyomasa has been at odds with you ever since the campaign in Korea. Moreover, he has not marched east this time, but remains in his own domain, coveting your lands. If you lose time here, disorder may well break out in your domain.” Mitsunari’s words pierced Yukinaga’s innards like a sharp needle, deepening his unease.

units.source_en: “Kiyomasa has been at odds with you ever since the campaign in Korea. Moreover, he has not marched east this time, but remains in his own domain, coveting your lands.

ja.t: でした。そのうえ、このたび

units.source_zh: “自从出兵高丽以来，清正就一直与大人不和，并且，清正此次也未东征，而是在他的领内觊觎你的土地。

units.source_en: If you lose time here, disorder may well break out in your domain.”
units.source_zh: 在这里耗费时日，你领内恐有骚乱之忧啊。”

units.source_en: Mitsunari’s words pierced Yukinaga’s innards like a sharp needle, deepening his unease.
units.source_zh: 三成这话就像一根利针扎进了行长脏腑，让他更是不安。

paragraphs.source_zh: “自从出兵高丽以来，清正就一直与大人不和，并且，清正此次也未东征，而是在他的领内觊觎你的土地。在这里耗费时日，你领内恐有骚乱之忧啊。”三成这话就像一根利针扎进了行长脏腑，让他更是不安。

paragraphs.source_en: That night, Mitsunari also called in succession upon Mōri Hidemoto and Kikkawa Hiroie, advising them to advance toward Seta. Clearly, Mitsunari had no intention of spending any more time on the assault upon Fushimi; this already showed his grasp of the larger situation.

units.source_en: That night, Mitsunari also called in succession upon Mōri Hidemoto and Kikkawa Hiroie, advising them to advance toward Seta.
units.source_zh: 是夜，三成还接连走访了毛利秀元和吉川广家，建议他们向濑田进发。

units.source_en: Clearly, Mitsunari had no intention of spending any more time on the assault upon Fushimi; this already showed his grasp of the larger situation.

ja.t: やすつもりのないことは
らかであり、そこにはすでに

units.source_zh: 显然，三成并不想在进攻伏见上花费更多时日，这已然显示出他对全局的把握。

paragraphs.source_zh: 是夜，三成还接连走访了毛利秀元和吉川广家，建议他们向濑田进发。显然，三成并不想在进攻伏见上花费更多时日，这已然显示出他对全局的把握。

paragraphs.source_en: Thus urged on by Mitsunari, the besieging forces launched another fierce assault on Fushimi Castle at midnight. Stirred up by Mitsunari, the warriors’ fury flared anew.

units.source_en: Thus urged on by Mitsunari, the besieging forces launched another fierce assault on Fushimi Castle at midnight.
units.source_zh: 就这样，在三成的督促下，到了半夜，围城部众再次向伏见城发起了猛烈的攻击。

units.source_en: Stirred up by Mitsunari, the warriors’ fury flared anew.
units.source_zh: 将士在三成的煽动下，又重燃怒火。

paragraphs.source_zh: 就这样，在三成的督促下，到了半夜，围城部众再次向伏见城发起了猛烈的攻击。将士在三成的煽动下，又重燃怒火。

paragraphs.source_en: Beginning on the twenty-sixth, they mounted fierce assaults for four successive days; yet the besiegers fought each in their own way, so it was hardly surprising that the battle made no progress.

units.source_en: Beginning on the twenty-sixth, they mounted fierce assaults for four successive days; yet the besiegers fought each in their own way, so it was hardly surprising that the battle made no progress.
units.source_zh: 二十六日起，尽管接连四日发起强攻，但攻城之众各自为战，战事迟迟没有进展也就不足为奇。

paragraphs.source_zh: 二十六日起，尽管接连四日发起强攻，但攻城之众各自为战，战事迟迟没有进展也就不足为奇。

paragraphs.source_en: The general assault launched at dawn on the thirtieth was extraordinarily savage. By dusk, the two sides had clashed four times. Whenever the attackers drew near, the defenders came racing like a swarm of locusts and drove them back with desperate force. The fierce fighting continued deep into the night.

units.source_en: The general assault launched at dawn on the thirtieth was extraordinarily savage.
units.source_zh: 从三十日拂晓发起的总攻，战况极其惨烈。

units.source_en: By dusk, the two sides had clashed four times.
units.source_zh: 到黄昏时，双方已然交战四次。

units.source_en: Whenever the attackers drew near, the defenders came racing like a swarm of locusts and drove them back with desperate force.
units.source_zh: 每当攻城一方逼近，守城士卒就如飞蝗般疾驰过来，拼尽死力把敌人击退。

units.source_en: The fierce fighting continued deep into the night.
units.source_zh: 激战一直持续到深夜。

paragraphs.source_zh: 从三十日拂晓发起的总攻，战况极其惨烈。到黄昏时，双方已然交战四次。每当攻城一方逼近，守城士卒就如飞蝗般疾驰过来，拼尽死力把敌人击退。激战一直持续到深夜。

paragraphs.source_en: Before dawn on the first day of the eighth month, flames atop the turret at the Pine Enclosure lit the heavens.

units.source_en: Before dawn on the first day of the eighth month, flames atop the turret at the Pine Enclosure lit the heavens.
units.source_zh: 八月初一凌晨，松苑箭楼上，烈焰照亮了长空。

paragraphs.source_zh: 八月初一凌晨，松苑箭楼上，烈焰照亮了长空。

paragraphs.source_en: At the sight of the signal, Natsuka’s troops were the first to launch a furious assault, while the Kobayakawa and Nabeshima forces likewise seized the moment to press toward the walls.

units.source_en: At the sight of the signal, Natsuka’s troops were the first to launch a furious assault, while the Kobayakawa and Nabeshima forces likewise seized the moment to press toward the walls.
units.source_zh: 一看到信号，长束的部队最先发动了猛攻，小早川和锅岛的人马也不失时机向城墙逼近。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一看到信号，长束的部队最先发动了猛攻，小早川和锅岛的人马也不失时机向城墙逼近。

paragraphs.source_en: The castle had fallen into confusion. Even had there been no confusion, the defenders were too few and would have been hard-pressed to answer an assault on every front.

units.source_en: The castle had fallen into confusion.
units.source_zh: 城内已陷入混乱。

units.source_en: Even had there been no confusion, the defenders were too few and would have been hard-pressed to answer an assault on every front.
units.source_zh: 即使不乱，由于守城人数不足，他们也会因对方的全面攻击而疲于应付。

paragraphs.source_zh: 城内已陷入混乱。即使不乱，由于守城人数不足，他们也会因对方的全面攻击而疲于应付。

paragraphs.source_en: “The Pine Enclosure is on fire!” At first, they thought it had been set ablaze by the enemy’s fire arrows. But when they discovered a great breach beside the nearby castle gate and saw the enemy pouring in through it, they realized that something had gone terribly wrong.

units.source_en: “The Pine Enclosure is on fire!”
units.source_zh: “松苑着火了！”

units.source_en: At first, they thought it had been set ablaze by the enemy’s fire arrows.
units.source_zh: 开始时，人们还以为是敌人的火箭引起。

units.source_en: But when they discovered a great breach beside the nearby castle gate and saw the enemy pouring in through it, they realized that something had gone terribly wrong.
units.source_zh: 可等他们发现旁边的城门已然出现了一条巨大的口子，敌人已从那里入侵时，才明白事情有变。

paragraphs.source_zh: “松苑着火了！”开始时，人们还以为是敌人的火箭引起。可等他们发现旁边的城门已然出现了一条巨大的口子，敌人已从那里入侵时，才明白事情有变。

paragraphs.source_en: “Traitors! There are traitors among us!”

units.source_en: “Traitors!
units.source_zh: “叛贼！

units.source_en: There are traitors among us!”
units.source_zh: 出现了叛贼！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “叛贼！出现了叛贼！”

paragraphs.source_en: The blaze rising from the Pine Enclosure seemed to mock the defenders, its tongues of flame leaping ever higher and burning ever more fiercely. As everyone fell into confusion, the main gate in which Toyotomi Hideyoshi had once taken such pride also caught fire. Narita Jūemon and Kawanami Sakuemon, retainers of Nabeshima Katsushige, were pressing their assault there, and it was Kawanami Sakuemon himself who set the fire.

units.source_en: The blaze rising from the Pine Enclosure seemed to mock the defenders, its tongues of flame leaping ever higher and burning ever more fiercely.
units.source_zh: 松苑燃起的火焰仿佛在嘲笑守城之众，火舌猛窜，愈烧愈猛。

units.source_en: As everyone fell into confusion, the main gate in which Toyotomi Hideyoshi had once taken such pride also caught fire.
units.source_zh: 当大家因此陷入混乱时，丰臣秀吉曾引以为豪的正门也燃烧起来。

units.source_en: Narita Jūemon and Kawanami Sakuemon, retainers of Nabeshima Katsushige, were pressing their assault there, and it was Kawanami Sakuemon himself who set the fire.
units.source_zh: 锅岛胜茂的手下成田十右卫门和川浪作右卫门正在强力进攻此处，这火就是川浪作右卫门亲手所放。

paragraphs.source_zh: 松苑燃起的火焰仿佛在嘲笑守城之众，火舌猛窜，愈烧愈猛。当大家因此陷入混乱时，丰臣秀吉曾引以为豪的正门也燃烧起来。锅岛胜茂的手下成田十右卫门和川浪作右卫门正在强力进攻此处，这火就是川浪作右卫门亲手所放。

paragraphs.source_en: Before the great gate had burned down, the forces of Kobayakawa, Nabeshima, Sagara, and others raced one another into the castle; the Kobayakawa and Sagara men even began killing one another in their struggle for glory.

units.source_en: Before the great gate had burned down, the forces of Kobayakawa, Nabeshima, Sagara, and others raced one another into the castle; the Kobayakawa and Sagara men even began killing one another in their struggle for glory.
units.source_zh: 大门烧毁之前，小早川、锅岛、相良等人的人马争先恐后冲进来，其中，小早川与相良的人马甚至为争功自相残杀。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大门烧毁之前，小早川、锅岛、相良等人的人马争先恐后冲进来，其中，小早川与相良的人马甚至为争功自相残杀。

paragraphs.source_en: The defenders no longer had the strength to halt the enemy’s advance.

units.source_en: The defenders no longer had the strength to halt the enemy’s advance.
units.source_zh: 守城一方已无力再阻止敌人进攻了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 守城一方已无力再阻止敌人进攻了。

paragraphs.source_en: Fukao Seijūrō, who had continued resisting in the Pine Enclosure without knowing that the Kōga men had betrayed them, was taken alive. Matsudaira Chikamasa, who had been charged with guarding the main gate from the outset and had earlier resisted the enemy assaulting the Nagoya Enclosure, hurried to the rescue, fought the enemy with his long spear, and gave his life for the castle.

units.source_en: Fukao Seijūrō, who had continued resisting in the Pine Enclosure without knowing that the Kōga men had betrayed them, was taken alive.
units.source_zh: 一直在松苑抵抗、还不知甲贺众已叛变的深尾清十郎被生擒。

units.source_en: Matsudaira Chikamasa, who had been charged with guarding the main gate from the outset and had earlier resisted the enemy assaulting the Nagoya Enclosure, hurried to the rescue, fought the enemy with his long spear, and gave his life for the castle.
units.source_zh: 此前抵抗攻打名护屋苑的入侵之敌，从一开始就负责守卫正门的松平近正急忙赶来救援，以长枪与敌人厮杀，以身殉城。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一直在松苑抵抗、还不知甲贺众已叛变的深尾清十郎被生擒。此前抵抗攻打名护屋苑的入侵之敌，从一开始就负责守卫正门的松平近正急忙赶来救援，以长枪与敌人厮杀，以身殉城。

paragraphs.source_en: The enemy’s onslaught grew ever more irresistible; the breach opened from within by the Kōga men had sealed the fate of Fushimi Castle.

units.source_en: The enemy’s onslaught grew ever more irresistible; the breach opened from within by the Kōga men had sealed the fate of Fushimi Castle.
units.source_zh: 敌人的进攻越来越势不可挡，甲贺众在里边打开的突破口，决定了伏见城的命运。

paragraphs.source_zh: 敌人的进攻越来越势不可挡，甲贺众在里边打开的突破口，决定了伏见城的命运。

paragraphs.source_en: The Nagoya Enclosure fell; all eighty-five of Chikamasa’s men who had held the main gate died in battle, and the Western and Drum Enclosures were also surrounded by the enemy…

units.source_en: The Nagoya Enclosure fell; all eighty-five of Chikamasa’s men who had held the main gate died in battle, and the Western and Drum Enclosures were also surrounded by the enemy…
units.source_zh: 名护屋苑陷落，坚守正门的近正属下八十五名士众全部战死，西苑和太鼓苑也已陷入敌人包围……

paragraphs.source_zh: 名护屋苑陷落，坚守正门的近正属下八十五名士众全部战死，西苑和太鼓苑也已陷入敌人包围……

paragraphs.source_en: As the darkness slowly receded, the fire in the Pine Enclosure spread before the morning wind, and the Nagoya and Drum Enclosures likewise became seas of flame.

units.source_en: As the darkness slowly receded, the fire in the Pine Enclosure spread before the morning wind, and the Nagoya and Drum Enclosures likewise became seas of flame.
units.source_zh: 夜色逐渐退去，在晨风的吹拂下，松苑的大火不断蔓延，名护屋苑和太鼓苑亦成了一片火海。

paragraphs.source_zh: 夜色逐渐退去，在晨风的吹拂下，松苑的大火不断蔓延，名护屋苑和太鼓苑亦成了一片火海。

paragraphs.source_en: At this point, Kobayakawa Hideaki temporarily halted the fighting and sent a man to negotiate with Torii Mototada, who was still battling in the inner castle. Mototada flatly refused: “I have said more than once that I shall hold out to the very end! Do not imagine that Torii Mototada is as spineless as those Kōga men.”

units.source_en: At this point, Kobayakawa Hideaki temporarily halted the fighting and sent a man to negotiate with Torii Mototada, who was still battling in the inner castle. Mototada flatly refused: “I have said more than once that I shall hold out to the very end!
units.source_zh: 此时，小早川秀秋暂时休战，命人与依然在本城奋战的鸟居元忠谈判，被元忠断然拒绝：“我不止说过一次，一定要坚守到底！

units.source_en: Do not imagine that Torii Mototada is as spineless as those Kōga men.”
units.source_zh: 休要以为鸟居元忠也如甲贺众那般没有骨气。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，小早川秀秋暂时休战，命人与依然在本城奋战的鸟居元忠谈判，被元忠断然拒绝：“我不止说过一次，一定要坚守到底！休要以为鸟居元忠也如甲贺众那般没有骨气。”

paragraphs.source_en: There had been no room for agreement from the start; the parley merely allowed the attackers a brief respite. Before long, the two sides were again locked in savage street fighting. The Shimazu troops also attacked, advancing upon the residence of the Jibu-shōyū to the left of the main gate.

units.source_en: There had been no room for agreement from the start; the parley merely allowed the attackers a brief respite.
units.source_zh: 和谈从一开始就没有商量的余地，只是让进攻一方暂时喘了一口气。

units.source_en: Before long, the two sides were again locked in savage street fighting.
units.source_zh: 不久，双方又进入了激烈的巷战。

units.source_en: The Shimazu troops also attacked, advancing upon the residence of the Jibu-shōyū to the left of the main gate.
units.source_zh: 岛津的部队亦发起了进攻，逼近正门左侧的治部少辅府邸。

paragraphs.source_zh: 和谈从一开始就没有商量的余地，只是让进攻一方暂时喘了一口气。不久，双方又进入了激烈的巷战。岛津的部队亦发起了进攻，逼近正门左侧的治部少辅府邸。

paragraphs.source_en: Day broke fully. The castle that had once woven the late Taikō’s sumptuous dreams burned fiercely, wailing beneath the copper-red sunlight…

units.source_en: Day broke fully. The castle that had once woven the late Taikō’s sumptuous dreams burned fiercely, wailing beneath the copper-red sunlight…
units.source_zh: 天色大亮，这座曾经编织了已故太阁豪华之梦的城池在熊熊燃烧，在赤铜色的阳光下大声呜咽……

paragraphs.source_zh: 天色大亮，这座曾经编织了已故太阁豪华之梦的城池在熊熊燃烧，在赤铜色的阳光下大声呜咽……

paragraphs.source_en: At the hour of the Snake, Matsudaira Ietada, who had rushed to the Jibu-shōyū residence to hold off the enemy, sent word to Torii Mototada: “The residence has fallen…”

units.source_en: At the hour of the Snake, Matsudaira Ietada, who had rushed to the Jibu-shōyū residence to hold off the enemy, sent word to Torii Mototada: “The residence has fallen…”
units.source_zh: 巳时，赶赴治部少辅府邸阻击的松平家忠，给鸟居元忠送来一条消息：“府邸陷落……”

paragraphs.source_zh: 巳时，赶赴治部少辅府邸阻击的松平家忠，给鸟居元忠送来一条消息：“府邸陷落……”

paragraphs.source_en: Before the messenger could finish, Mototada cut him off: “What of Tonosuke?”

units.source_en: Before the messenger could finish, Mototada cut him off: “What of Tonosuke?”
units.source_zh: 没等对方把话说完，元忠便打断了报信人：“主殿助呢？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 没等对方把话说完，元忠便打断了报信人：“主殿助呢？”

paragraphs.source_en: “He encountered Bessho Shimotsuke, one of Shimazu’s commanders, and fought him fiercely, but the enemy came on in swarms and surrounded my lord on every side…”

units.source_en: “He encountered Bessho Shimotsuke, one of Shimazu’s commanders, and fought him fiercely, but the enemy came on in swarms and surrounded my lord on every side…”
units.source_zh: “与岛津的部将别所下野遭遇，奋力与其厮杀，可是敌人成群结队拥上来，把大人重重包围……”

paragraphs.source_zh: “与岛津的部将别所下野遭遇，奋力与其厮杀，可是敌人成群结队拥上来，把大人重重包围……”

paragraphs.source_en: “Enough rambling! What happened to him?”

units.source_en: “Enough rambling!
units.source_zh: “休要啰唆！

units.source_en: What happened to him?”
units.source_zh: 到底怎样了？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “休要啰唆！到底怎样了？”

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord ordered us to tell you that he drove back the enemy and then died by seppuku!”

units.source_en: “My lord ordered us to tell you that he drove back the enemy and then died by seppuku!”
